chains.title: No TF-mediated allelic effect
predictions: No allele-specific binding of GABPA, ELK1, E2F1, or other candidate TFs at rs34768248.
No allele-specific effect in a TERT promoter reporter assay.
No rs34768248 genotype effect on TERT mRNA/protein in glioblastoma lines.
Any disease association is explained by linkage disequilibrium with another causal variant or by a passenger event.
falsified_if: A robust allele-specific TF binding difference is demonstrated at rs34768248.
An allele-specific TERT reporter effect is demonstrated and depends on the candidate TF binding site.

chains.title: Alt allele increases GABPA binding at the TERT promoter

links.claim: GABPA binds the alt A allele more strongly than the ref G allele; GABPA is chosen as the TERT-promoter ETS-family factor from literature knowledge, not from provided QBiC-SELEX evidence.
rs34768248 lies in a TERT promoter/regulatory element where an ETS/GABPA site can affect promoter activity.
Increased GABPA occupancy at this element increases TERT transcription.
TERT is expressed and the TERT promoter is active in glioblastoma cells, including the DepMap glioblastoma context.
Higher TERT expression/telomerase activity promotes glioblastoma, and the same element may contribute in melanoma and bladder cancer.

predictions: GABPA ChIP-qPCR at the rs34768248 element: alt allele occupied more.
TERT promoter reporter: alt > ref, reduced by GABPA-site mutation or GABPA knockdown.
TERT mRNA/protein higher with alt allele in suitable glioblastoma lines.
falsified_if: GABPA shows no allele-specific binding at rs34768248.
The alt allele does not increase TERT reporter activity or TERT expression in the relevant cellular context.

chains.title: Alt allele increases ELK1 binding at the TERT promoter

links.claim: ELK1, another ETS-family factor, binds the alt A allele more strongly than ref G at a candidate ETS-like motif created or strengthened by the variant.
The variant lies in a TERT promoter/regulatory element where ETS-family occupancy can modulate transcription.
Increased ELK1 occupancy at this element increases TERT transcription.
ELK1 is expressed and TERT promoter is active in glioblastoma cells.
Increased TERT expression/telomerase activity contributes to glioblastoma and possibly melanoma and bladder cancer.

predictions: ELK1 ChIP-qPCR at the rs34768248 element: alt allele occupied more.
TERT reporter: alt > ref, reduced by ELK1 knockdown but not by GABPA knockdown.
TERT mRNA/protein higher with alt allele.
falsified_if: ELK1 shows no allele-specific binding at rs34768248.
The allele-specific TERT reporter effect is lost only with GABPA perturbation and not with ELK1 perturbation.

chains.title: Alt allele loses repressive E2F1 binding and derepresses TERT

links.claim: E2F1 binds the ref G allele more strongly than the alt A allele; the alt allele is predicted to weaken an E2F1-like repressive site.
rs34768248 lies in a TERT promoter/regulatory element where loss of a repressive factor can increase promoter activity.
Reduced E2F1 occupancy at this element derepresses TERT transcription.
E2F1 is expressed in glioblastoma cells and TERT is expressed in the DepMap glioblastoma context.
Derepressed TERT increases telomerase activity and contributes to glioblastoma, melanoma, and bladder cancer.

predictions: E2F1 ChIP-qPCR at the rs34768248 element: ref allele occupied more.
TERT reporter: alt > ref, and the effect is reduced by an E2F1-site mutation or E2F1 overexpression.
TERT mRNA/protein higher with alt allele.
falsified_if: E2F1 shows no allele-specific binding at rs34768248.
The alt allele does not increase TERT reporter activity or TERT expression.
The allele-specific effect is instead explained by an activating ETS factor such as GABPA.

matrix.test: TERT promoter reporter, ref vs alt

outcomes.outcome: alt > ref reporter activity; GABPA-site mutation or knockdown reduces effect
alt > ref reporter activity; ELK1 knockdown reduces effect
alt > ref reporter activity; E2F1-site mutation or E2F1 overexpression reduces effect

next_experiment: Run the cheapest discriminating experiment: allele-specific EMSA with recombinant GABPA on ref-G and alt-A oligos spanning rs34768248. A clear alt > ref GABPA shift supports H1_GABPA over H0_null; no differential GABPA binding supports H0_null over H1_GABPA.
